limitations: prototype only; not wired into the production API or approval catalog
bounded evidence covers two retained four-pair episodes, not every seed
the parameter affects only pink rectangles with an even approached axis
odd-axis pink rectangles and all gray behavior are identical across settings
the production canonical authority remains the lower setting only

dependent_input_constraints: each pair has at least one pink rectangle with an even axis
a pink exterior dot approaches along that even axis
three demonstrations each distinguish lower from upper before the query
invariant_reasoning: identify filled gray and pink rectangles
associate each exterior dot with exactly one rectangle edge
erase gray rectangles and copy gray dots to the inner edge
retain pink rectangles, clear pink source dots, and move them to a center axis
parameter.name: pink_center_tie

lower.racket_program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((shapes-raw (objects g 0))
                  (shapes (filter (lambda (o)
                                    (or (= (obj-color o) 5) (= (obj-color o) 6)))
                                  shapes-raw))
                  (shape-infos (map (lambda (o)
                                      (let ((bb (obj-bbox o)))
                                        (list (obj-color o)
                                              (first bb)
                                              (second bb)
                                              (third bb)
                                              (fourth bb)
                                              (obj-cells o))))
                                    shapes))
                  (dots (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)) #:when (= (at g r c) 9))
                          (list r c)))
                  (g1 (for/fold ((out g))
                        ((si shape-infos))
                        (cond
                          ((= (first si) 5) (for/fold ((gg out))
                              ((cell (sixth si)))
                              (set-cell gg (first cell) (second cell) 8)))
                          (else out))))
                  (g2 (for/fold ((out g1))
                        ((dot dots))
                        (let ((dr (first dot))
                              (dc (second dot)))
                          (let loop
                               ((ss shape-infos))
                               (cond
                                 ((null? ss) out)
                                 (else (let* ((si (car ss))
                                              (color (first si))
                                              (r1 (second si))
                                              (c1 (third si))
                                              (r2 (fourth si))
                                              (c2 (fifth si))
                                              (in-rows (and (>= dr r1) (<= dr r2)))
                                              (in-cols (and (>= dc c1) (<= dc c2)))
                                              (left? (and in-rows (= dc (- c1 1))))
                                              (right? (and in-rows (= dc (+ c2 1))))
                                              (above? (and in-cols (= dr (- r1 1))))
                                              (below? (and in-cols (= dr (+ r2 1))))
                                              (lr? (or left? right?))
                                              (ud? (or above? below?)))
                                         (cond
                                           ((or lr? ud?) (cond
                                               ((= color 6) (let* ((mid-r (quotient (+ r1 r2) 2))
                                                        (mid-c (quotient (+ c1 c2) 2))
                                                        (nr (if lr? dr mid-r))
                                                        (nc (if lr? mid-c dc)))
                                                   (set-cell (set-cell out dr dc 8)
                                                             nr
                                                             nc
                                                             9)))
                                               (else (let* ((ar (cond
                                                                  (left? dr)
                                                                  (right? dr)
                                                                  (above? r1)
                                                                  (below? r2)))
                                                            (ac (cond
                                                                  (left? c1)
                                                                  (right? c2)
                                                                  (above? dc)
                                                                  (below? dc))))
                                                       (set-cell out ar ac 9)))))
                                           (else (loop (cdr ss))))))))))))
             g2))))
